entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your stare causes your foe to bleed out of its eyes.

Prerequisite(s): Mesmerist level 5th, painful stare class feature.

Benefit(s): When you trigger your painful stare, the target takes an amount of bleed damage equal to 1/3 your mesmerist level. Bleed damage from multiple uses of Bleeding Stare doesn’t stack.
